text: DSH Connect AI-Toolkit 是 DSH Web 客户端的模型接入插件，可将本机 AI-Toolkit 代理中的 WorkBuddy、TRAE 和 Qoder 模型接入 DSH。它注册独立模型提供方，在配置页展示新会话默认模型选择，并自动发现代理地址、读取模型目录后转发推理请求。用户可同步模型状态、按模型设置上下文与输出预算，并将选择保存为 DSH 实际的新会话默认模型。适合已通过 AI-Toolkit 管理模型、希望在 DSH 中选用这些模型的用户；需要本机运行 AI-Toolkit 并允许宿主读取系统凭据。

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit connects WorkBuddy, TRAE, and Qoder models from a local AI-Toolkit proxy to DSH. It discovers models, registers an inference provider, and lets users choose the default model for new sessions. Requires AI-Toolkit running locally.
想在 DSH 里使用 AI-Toolkit 已连接的模型。
能不能自动找到本机代理里的模型，不手动填地址和密钥？
我想把 TRAE 或 Qoder 模型设成 DSH 新会话默认模型。
如何让 DSH 同步本地模型代理提供的模型目录？
想在 DSH 中调用兼容 OpenAI Chat Completions 的本机模型服务。
不同模型需要不同上下文预算，能在 DSH 里分别设置吗？
How can I use models from my local AI-Toolkit proxy in DSH?
Can DSH discover my local model catalog and choose a default for new sessions?
DSH Connect AI-Toolkit 的功能「本机代理自动发现」：插件读取 AI-Toolkit 本地数据库中的代理端口，并从系统凭据库读取代理凭据；宿主启动后自动检测连接状态。
DSH Connect AI-Toolkit 的功能「代理模型目录同步」：连接本机代理后，插件查询模型目录并同步模型标识及可用的上下文和输出上限，供 DSH 提供方呈现。
DSH Connect AI-Toolkit 的功能「新会话默认模型选择」：配置页可选择代理目录中的模型；插件通过 DSH 默认模型服务保存选择，并读回确认保存结果。
DSH Connect AI-Toolkit 的功能「模型推理适配」：插件使用 OpenAI Chat Completions 协议连接本地代理，支持流式响应并将请求限定到配置的聊天接口。
DSH Connect AI-Toolkit 的功能「模型预算覆盖」：可为单个模型设置上下文窗口、最大输出 token 数及图片输入选项；适配器按覆盖值构造模型配置。
DSH Connect AI-Toolkit 使用前须知：自动连接依赖同一系统用户运行的本机 AI-Toolkit，并需经系统凭据库读取代理密钥；用户需先在 AI-Toolkit 连接账号并启用代理。
DSH Connect AI-Toolkit 使用前须知：模型默认值只影响之后创建的新会话，已有会话仍需在会话内切换模型。

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · 界面截图：真实 macOS Harness 界面：已自动连接代理并读取模型。左侧工作区、会话、账号信息和本地路径已打码。

选择模型后显示对应平台 Logo。下图使用模拟目录展示 Qoder 的选中效果：

[深色主题](docs/assets/settings-dark.png) · [未连接状态](docs/assets/settings-disconnected.png) · [窄屏预览](docs/assets/settings-mobile.png)

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · 使用：1. 打开 AI-Toolkit，在“积分与代理”中连接账号、同步模型目录并开启本地代理。
2. 在 DSH 安装并启用本插件，打开“插件 → DSH Connect AI-Toolkit”配置页。
3. 在“新会话默认模型”中选择模型，选择结果会保存到 **DSH 实际的默认模型配置**，用于之后的新会话。

DSH 和 AI-Toolkit 应使用同一个系统账号、在同一台机器运行。地址相对于 DSH 宿主进程；插件配置页面须在本机访问该 DSH 宿主。系统首次读取凭据可能要求授权，允许后点击下拉框重试。

插件供应商标识为 `ai-toolkit-connect`，在 DSH 中显示为 **AI-Toolkit（自动连接）**，可与已有的 `ai-toolkit` 通用代理配置共存。

模型选项保留完整 ID 和来源，全部模型仍出现在 DSH 会话自身的模型选择器中。插件不会过滤模型目录来假装切换，也不会改写模型调用 ID。**已有会话继续使用其原模型，请在该会话内切换**；本插件的字段修改的是 DSH 的新会话默认值，而不是独立的提供商偏好。
DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · 自动连接与恢复：插件只读查询当前用户 `~/.ai-toolkit/ai-toolkit.db` 中的本地代理端口设置，并通过操作系统凭据库读取代理 API Key；连接信息只保存在宿主内存中，不返回浏览器、不写入插件配置或日志。账号登录、余额和积分领取继续在 AI-Toolkit 中管理。

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · 自动连接与恢复：- 未安装、应用未打开或代理未开启时，下拉框保留键盘焦点，说明如何恢复并提供下载链接。点击下拉框可重新检测。
- 系统凭据访问被拒绝后暂停自动授权重试；允许访问后，点击下拉框再试，避免后台反复弹窗。
- 首次安装、启用和热重载产生的多个插件实例，共用当前 Harness 宿主进程中的同一笔凭据读取；授权弹窗等待期间不再排队发起重复请求。成功结果及取消／拒绝状态均跨实例保留；取消／拒绝后，只有明确点击下拉框重试才重新授权。密钥只保留在宿主内存，退出进程后释放，不新增钥匙串副本。
- 模型目录来自现有 `GET /v1/models`。连接正常时每 30 秒同步，断线时检查恢复；界面每 5 秒读取宿主状态。
- 已有连接遇到 HTTP 503、超时或临时端口元数据错误时保留内存密钥，不反复访问凭据库。端口改变时先验证已有代理密钥。模型目录 HTTP 401 对同一代已通过鉴权的缓存只合并一次来源重读；首次尚未通过鉴权的密钥若被拒绝，则直接暂停，不紧接着再次授权。重读或认证仍失败后，需点击下拉框人工重试。
- 下拉框提交后，通过 DSH 公开的模型解析和默认模型服务保存，再读回确认。宿主缺少配置编辑服务、模型失效或保存不成功时，会明确报错，不将未生效的本地偏好显示为成功。

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · 自动连接与恢复：插件不修改 AI-Toolkit 源码、账号记录或代理配置，不调用其凭据写入和删除操作。SQLite 使用只读连接和 `query_only`；WAL 模式下 SQLite 可能维护已有的共享内存索引。缺少必要 WAL 辅助文件时停止读取，不补建或修复文件。

此优化针对插件重复发起的授权请求，不保证操作系统永远只显示一次提示。真正重启宿主进程、钥匙串锁定、密钥轮换或应用身份变化时，系统仍可能重新询问；旧版分块凭据也可能按不同条目分别授权。

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · 安装与开发：开发要求 **Node.js 24.9 至 24.x**。公开安装包通过 GitHub Releases 提供；尚未发布到 npm。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/whyfail/dsh-connect-ai-toolkit.git
cd dsh-connect-ai-toolkit
npm ci
npm run check

在 DSH“插件 → 添加插件”中填写生成压缩包的绝对路径，安装并启用；或使用官方 CLI：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-connect-ai-toolkit-0.2.6.tgz
```

Electron 桌面的 `desktop` profile 由桌面应用管理，请通过桌面插件界面安装。`npm run preview` 是使用模拟数据的独立组件预览，不读取真实账号或产生模型调用。

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · 模型能力与范围：模型调用使用 AI-Toolkit 的 OpenAI Chat Completions 代理，保留流式响应与 DSH 工具调用。平台账号调度和实际权限由 AI-Toolkit 负责，模型目录发现不等于推理或工具能力已实测。

插件优先读取代理模型目录的 `context_window` 与 `max_output_tokens`，并传给 Harness／SDK；例如 MiniMax Code 声明的 1M 上下文会实际用于客户端预算，不再统一当作 32K。两种容量分别处理，未声明的最大输出不会用上下文窗口补齐。无相应元数据时分别回退到上下文 32,768 Token、最大输出 4,096 Token；图片输入仍默认关闭。旧版单模型显式预算优先于目录，其他旧预算作为缺失字段的回退。本版不提供预算或能力编辑控件，不展示或推断余额、价格等目录未返回的数据。

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · 模型能力与范围：自动发现需要对应版本的 AI-Toolkit 数据格式与系统凭据后端。macOS 使用其共享凭据中的代理条目，Windows/Linux 兼容其代理条目与分块布局；不枚举平台账号。跨平台真实运行的验收范围见 [验证记录](docs/VALIDATION.md)。

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · DSH Connect AI-Toolkit：Connect **WorkBuddy, TRAE / TRAE CN, and Qoder** models to DeepSeek Harness through the local [AI-Toolkit](https://github.com/whyfail/AI-Toolkit) proxy. The plugin UI contains one **new-session default model** dropdown. The DSH host discovers the proxy URL and key; neither requires manual input.

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · One-command installation：Supports **DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 / 0.2.1-rc.5 / 0.2.2-rc.1**. Run the desktop app at least once, then **fully quit Harness** before installing.

macOS, with the app in `/Applications`:

```sh
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add "https://github.com/whyfail/dsh-connect-ai-toolkit/releases/latest/download/dsh-connect-ai-toolkit.tgz"
```

Windows PowerShell, with the **desktop app's bundled CLI** on PATH:

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · One-command installation：```powershell
dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add "https://github.com/whyfail/dsh-connect-ai-toolkit/releases/latest/download/dsh-connect-ai-toolkit.tgz"
```

Reopen Harness and enable **Plugins → dsh-connect-ai-toolkit**. The standalone npm CLI cannot manage the desktop profile. DSH does not currently offer a web install protocol: the command downloads and installs the package, while activation is confirmed in the app.

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · One-command installation：Alternatively, [download the package](https://github.com/whyfail/dsh-connect-ai-toolkit/releases/latest/download/dsh-connect-ai-toolkit.tgz), enter its absolute path in **Plugins → Add plugin**, install, and enable it. [Releases](https://github.com/whyfail/dsh-connect-ai-toolkit/releases) include versioned packages and SHA-256 checksums. The package is not published to npm.

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · Usage：1. Run AI-Toolkit, connect your accounts, synchronize their model catalogs, and enable its local proxy.
2. Install and enable this plugin in DSH. Open **Plugins → DSH Connect AI-Toolkit**.
3. Choose a model in **新会话默认模型**. The plugin saves the **actual DSH deployment default**, used by subsequent new sessions.

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · Usage：DSH and AI-Toolkit must run under the same OS account on the same machine. The proxy address is resolved by the DSH host process; access the plugin configuration page locally on that DSH host machine. The OS may request permission to read the proxy credential. Allow access and click the dropdown to retry.

The plugin uses provider ID `ai-toolkit-connect`, displayed as **AI-Toolkit（自动连接）**, so it can coexist with an existing generic `ai-toolkit` proxy profile.

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · Usage：Options retain exact model IDs and sources. All models remain available in DSH's conversation model picker. The plugin does not simulate selection by hiding entries or rewriting inference IDs. **Existing sessions retain their current models; switch those in the conversation itself.** This field changes DSH's new-session default, not a provider-local preference.

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · Discovery and recovery：The plugin queries only proxy port settings from the current user's `~/.ai-toolkit/ai-toolkit.db` and reads the proxy key through the system credential store. Connection information stays in host memory, outside browser state, plugin configuration, and logs. Manage platform accounts, credits, and rewards in AI-Toolkit.

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · Discovery and recovery：- When AI-Toolkit is missing or its proxy is offline, the dropdown remains keyboard-focusable and shows recovery guidance plus a download link. Click it to retry discovery.
- Denied credential authorization pauses automatic authorization retries. Allow access, then click the dropdown to retry; background checks do not repeatedly prompt.
- Installation, activation, and hot reload share one in-flight credential read across plugin instances in the same Harness host process. Successful reads and cancelled/denied outcomes survive those instance replacements. After cancellation or denial, only an explicit dropdown retry resumes the read. The proxy key stays in process memory, with no additional keychain copy, and is released when the host process exits.
- Models come from the existing `GET /v1/models` endpoint. The host synchronizes every 30 seconds while connected and checks for recovery after failures. The UI reads host state every five seconds.
- HTTP 503, timeouts, and temporary port-metadata failures retain the in-memory key. A changed port first validates the existing proxy key. Model-catalog HTTP 401 coalesces one source re-re

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · Discovery and recovery：The plugin does not modify AI-Toolkit source, account records, or proxy configuration, and never invokes credential writes or deletion for AI-Toolkit entries. SQLite uses a read-only connection with `query_only`; WAL mode may maintain existing shared-memory indexes. Discovery stops if required WAL sidecars are missing, rather than creating or repairing them.

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · Discovery and recovery：This prevents duplicate plugin requests, not every possible OS prompt. A real host-process restart, locked keychain, key rotation, or changed application identity may require authorization again. Legacy chunk records may also require separate item permissions.

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · Installation and development：Supports **DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 / 0.2.1-rc.5 / 0.2.2-rc.1** with **Node.js 24.9 through 24.x**. Source and local npm tarball installation are provided; these instructions do not assume a published npm package.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/whyfail/dsh-connect-ai-toolkit.git
cd dsh-connect-ai-toolkit
npm ci
npm run check

Enter the generated tarball's absolute path in DSH's **Plugins → Add plugin**, then install and enable it. Alternatively, use the official CLI:

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · Installation and development：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-connect-ai-toolkit-0.2.6.tgz
```

The Electron `desktop` profile is managed by the desktop application; install through its plugin UI. `npm run preview` starts an isolated component preview with mock state, without real accounts or model calls. The settings UI is Chinese-first.

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · Capabilities and limits：Inference uses AI-Toolkit's OpenAI Chat Completions proxy, including streaming and DSH tool calls. AI-Toolkit owns platform account routing and actual model permissions. Catalog discovery is not proof of inference or tool compatibility.

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · Capabilities and limits：The plugin reads `context_window` and `max_output_tokens` from the proxy catalog and passes them to Harness and the SDK. A declared 1M MiniMax Code context therefore uses 1M for client budgeting rather than a fixed 32K. Context capacity never substitutes for an unknown output limit. Missing fields independently fall back to 32,768 context tokens and 4,096 output tokens; image input remains disabled. Explicit legacy per-model budgets take precedence, while other legacy budgets serve as fallbacks. This version has no budget/capability editor and does not infer balances, prices, or other absent metadata.

DSH Connect AI-Toolkit README · Capabilities and limits：Automatic discovery depends on supported AI-Toolkit data formats and OS credential backends. macOS reads the proxy entry from its shared record; Windows/Linux support its proxy record and chunk layout without enumerating platform accounts. See [validation notes](docs/VALIDATION.md) for the exact scope of real-platform testing.
